rows: Table salt
Finely ground halite, iodized (KI added), anti-caking agents
Kosher salt
Coarser crystal, no iodine, no anti-caking agents. Draws blood from meat (kashering). No religious content in the salt itself.
Sea salt
Solar-evaporated seawater. Trace mineral profile varies by source but nutritionally similar to table salt
Fleur de sel
First delicate crystals that form on surface of evaporation ponds. Premium texture, quick-dissolving, finishing salt
Himalayan pink salt
Rock salt from Khewra Mine, Pakistan. Iron oxide pigment. ~97% NaCl.
"Low sodium" salt
KCl substitution for NaCl. Works for mild reduction. Metallic taste at high substitution.
Why is black pepper black?
Dried while green/unripe; oxidation during drying
Why is white pepper different flavor?
Ripe berry, hull removed — different volatile profile
Why does piperine matter medicinally?
CYP3A4 inhibitor — increases bioavailability of many drugs/compounds
Why did Venice control European spice trade?
Chokepoint access to Levantine ports — classic platform monopoly
What preservation mechanism does salt use?
Osmotic dehydration lowers water activity below microbial growth threshold
Why is Himalayan pink salt pink?
Iron oxide (Fe₂O₃) trace impurity. Not meaningfully different from table salt nutritionally.
What's the chemistry behind lacto-fermentation?
Salt selects Lactobacillus → lactic acid production → pH drops → preservation
Why did Portugal fund the Cape route?
To eliminate the Venice monopoly on a product with 60× markup from origin
